ads.title: Ads
ads.description: Spend and results per platform, by owner: the agency or a client. Figures are fetched from each API when you open this page if they are older than 15 minutes; “Refresh” fetches them right now.
ads.fetchedAgo: {minutes, plural, =0 {refreshed just now} one {refreshed # minute ago} other {refreshed # minutes ago}}

totals.title: Spend over the last 28 days
totals.hint: Ad spend paid to the platforms, not GNERAI billing. Each currency is summed separately.

section.sharesGoogle: YouTube Ads uses the same connection as Google Ads: once Google Ads is connected, its video campaigns show up here on their own.
section.error: Figures could not be read ({message}). The last snapshot is shown, if any.
section.campaignsHint: Performance per campaign over the period; includes campaigns without impressions.
section.archiveConfirm: This account stops being read and its credential is deleted. Campaigns linked to clients are unlinked.

sheet.title: Add an ad account
sheet.description: One connection per platform and owner. The credential is stored encrypted and only the server uses it to read figures.
sheet.label: Name

external.openai: Account ID (optional: the API provides it)

sheet.googleHint: Save the account, then press “Connect with Google” to authorise read access (adwords scope) with the Google account that sees that ad account.
sheet.createdGoogle: Account saved: now connect with Google

errors.duplicate: There is already an account for this platform and owner.
errors.notFound: That account no longer exists or you have no access.

flash.save: The campaign link could not be saved.
flash.api: The platform did not answer; try again.
flash.imported: Server key imported as a GNERAI account.
flash.not_configured: Google is not configured on the server (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY).
flash.permission: You have no permission to connect accounts.
flash.oauth_denied: You cancelled the authorisation at Google.
flash.oauth_scope: Google did not grant the Google Ads permission (adwords). Connect again and tick it.
flash.oauth_state: The connection expired or does not match your session. Try again.
flash.oauth_google: Google did not return a valid token.
flash.oauth_save: The connection could not be saved.

envKey.title: ChatGPT Ads key on the server
envKey.body: The server has an OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY in its environment. Import it as a GNERAI account to manage it here like the others; you can remove it from the environment afterwards.

ads.clientNote: Each client's portal only shows the campaigns marked “Portal” on their record; never the whole account nor other people's campaigns.
